in_marathi.name: Katha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Story, Tale, Myth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Katha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who carries a story, a tale, a myth. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'katha' which means 'story'. It is also the name of the ancient Indian epic 'Mahabharata', which is a collection of stories and wisdom. The name Katha is rich in spirituality and is believed to bring wisdom, knowledge and creativity.

vedic_reference.note: The name Katha is derived from the Sanskrit root 'kath' which means 'to relate, to tell'. In Hindu mythology, Katha is the name of a sage who is revered for his wisdom and knowledge. He is also the author of several important Hindu texts including the Mahabharata and the Katha Upanishad.
